protocol: Frozen r7 update-29 sampled policies, 7 current-Good marginals, fair-prior action/observation Bayesian targets; independent own-policy fit/test streams, all valid rows including reset, no warmup exclusion. Separate affine least squares (rcond 1e-6). Calibrated encoder = solve(EW,E); min-norm decoder = pseudoinverse(W). For each calibrated variant choose the smallest tuning λ with pooled Good→Bad pickup ≤0.10 AND Bad→Good pickup ≥0.5, else λ=1. Original encoder retains historical fallback λ=2. Choose displayed variant on tuning only by (Bad→Good pickup minus Good→Bad pickup minus maximum absolute nontarget conditional-rate drift from intact across directions/qualities); ties follow encoder, calibrated encoder, min-norm order. Freeze across agents/sites. Matched environment/action RNG across conditions; Bad→Good stops at first target pickup, Good→Bad continues every decision step. Cached K/V propagation preserved.
rendering_note: Only tuning-table Markdown headers changed after execution; sources records executed analysis, execution_source_commit identifies its immutable source, report_rendering_source_sha256 identifies final renderer.
